sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (standard Arogya Sanjeevani range ₹1L–₹5L)

room_rent.note: If actual room rent exceeds limit, all associated medical expenses are proportionately reduced

icu.note: Includes ICU/ICCU bed, monitoring, critical care nursing

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-pay applies to every admissible claim for all insured persons

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped; modern treatments 50% of SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: lower of 25% of SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year; modern treatments (robotic surgery etc.) capped at 50% of SI

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents; not applicable if continuously covered for 12+ months

ped_waiting.note: Reduced by prior continuous coverage under portability norms

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24 months for most listed conditions (cataract, hernia, etc.); 36 months for joint replacement and age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% of base SI added each year irrespective of claims; max 50% of base SI

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered; 24-hour hospitalisation requirement waived

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation and OPD treatment explicitly excluded (Section C, 3.3)

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expenses in the policy wording

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, stem cell therapy etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Extensive List I explicitly excludes consumables like gloves, masks, bandages, diapers etc.

global_cover.note: Treatment must be taken within India only (Section C 3.4 and Section D 2.4)

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; applies to enhanced SI from date of enhancement

grace_period.note: 30 days for yearly premium mode; 15 days for monthly/quarterly/half-yearly instalment modes

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; prior coverage credits transferred

notable_exclusions: Domiciliary & OPD, maternity, sterility/IVF, overseas treatment, war, nuclear/bio/chemical, refractive error <7.5D, consumables
